privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Fieldnotes is the engineering notebook for Robotique CIV's robotics teams. This page explains what data the application records, why, who can see it, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.controllerTitle: Who is responsible for your data
privacy.controller:
Robotique CIV, an association governed by the French law of 1901
190 rue Frédéric Mistral, 06560 Valbonne
Contact: {{contact}}
privacy.location: The application is installed on a club computer, on the club's premises. Your data is neither hosted by a service provider, sold nor shared with third parties. The only outgoing communication is confirmation emails.
privacy.loginIdentifier: your login identifier (your email address; if you do not have one, a fictional address is created for you and never receives anything);
privacy.displayName: your display name, visible to other members;
privacy.password: your password, stored in an irreversible protected form: nobody, including the club's administrators, can read it;
privacy.joinedAndRole: your registration date and role (student, mentor, administrator);
privacy.failedLogins: the number of consecutive incorrect password attempts and, if it reaches five, the time until which signing in is blocked.
privacy.accountWhy: Why: to let you sign in and work with your team, and to prevent password guessing through repeated attempts.
privacy.membership: When signing up, you enter your first name, last name and date of birth. They are used only to find your membership in the club's membership register (AssoConnect), then deleted. We then copy your membership number, date of birth and a contact address from AssoConnect: yours if you are an adult, or your legal guardian's if you are a minor.
privacy.membershipWhy: Why: to restrict the application to club members and know whether a member is a minor. The date recorded in AssoConnect is authoritative, rather than the date entered at sign-up.
privacy.consent: We keep a dated history of your decisions (consent or refusal), including who signed (you or your legal guardian). The signed document remains in AssoConnect. The club checks these decisions before publishing anything, and a refusal applies from its date. When a file is uploaded, the application records whether people are recognisable in it; the club uses this to know what to check before publication.
privacy.work: The notes, progress entries, decisions and handovers you write, with their dates, authors and participants. Your attendance on a workshop day is inferred from the progress entries you contributed to.
privacy.workWhy: Why: this is the tool's purpose — preserving the team's work from one session to the next and from one season to the next.
privacy.files: Photos, videos, drawings and CAD files attached to a record. A photo or video has its metadata removed, including the location where it was taken, and iPhone photos (HEIC) are converted to JPEG. They are visible only to the team and mentors; the uploader or a mentor can remove them.
privacy.filesWhy: Why: a prototype photo or trial video is often the most useful record of a session, and the portfolio needs the actual file.
privacy.photo: If you add a profile photo, it is resized and has its metadata removed, including the location where it was taken. It is visible only to signed-in members. You can delete it at any time.
privacy.questions: Every question you ask the rulebook assistant is recorded with its author, date and the rulebook passages it cited (see below).
privacy.cookies: The application uses two technical cookies essential to its operation: a session cookie that keeps you signed in, and a security cookie (CSRF) that prevents another site from acting on your behalf. There are no advertising or audience-measurement cookies.
privacy.students: Students see their team's work and the members contributing to it.
privacy.mentors: Mentors see all club teams' work so they can support them.
privacy.administrators: Club administrators manage teams, members and roles.
privacy.notebook: The notebook export, like the application, is an internal club working document used as material for competition portfolios. Nothing is published from the application: when preparing a portfolio or publication, the club checks image-consent decisions and excludes images of members who refused.
privacy.minors: Most of our members are minors. Use of the application is covered by club membership signed by the legal guardian in AssoConnect. A minor member's rights can be exercised by the member or their legal guardian, and confirmations are sent to the guardian's address.
privacy.assistant: The competition rulebook assistant runs entirely on the club's computer: it searches the official manual and official questions loaded on that computer, and no question is sent to an external service. Your questions are not shown to other members; they are part of your data and therefore included in your export.
privacy.retentionTitle: How long we keep your data
privacy.accountDuration: for as long as you are a member
privacy.departedData: The account of a member who leaves the club
privacy.departedDuration: anonymised on departure: the name becomes “Former member”; the photo, addresses, date of birth and membership number are erased, and the account can no longer be used to sign in
privacy.archivesDuration: kept as club archives; after anonymisation, they are no longer linked to your identity
privacy.verificationDuration: deleted once your membership is found, or with the account if no membership is ever matched
privacy.consentDuration: for as long as content concerning you exists
privacy.throttleDuration: a rolling minute; it resets a minute after the last attempt
privacy.suspension: A temporary account suspension decided by the club (see the <terms>terms of use</terms>) does not anonymise the account.
privacy.rights: You can at any time access your data, rectify it, request its erasure or receive a copy in a readable format. The application lets you request data export and deletion, with confirmation sent by email. For any other request, write to {{contact}}.
privacy.erasure: Erasure means anonymisation, just as when leaving the club: your identity disappears from the application, while your team's written records remain in its archives without your name.
privacy.complaint: If you believe your rights are not respected, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).
privacy.security: Communication with the application is encrypted (HTTPS), passwords are never stored in plain text, ten sign-in attempts per address per minute trigger a pause before the next one rather than blocking the targeted account, and every data access checks that you are signed in and authorised to view it.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Fieldnotes is the engineering notebook for the robotics teams of Robotique CIV, an association governed by the French law of 1901, 190 rue Frédéric Mistral, 06560 Valbonne (contact: {{contact}}). By creating an account, you accept the terms below.
terms.purpose: Fieldnotes records teams' work: progress during each session, what remains to do and what to hand over to those taking over. It also generates the engineering notebook used to prepare competition portfolios. It is reserved for this purpose.
terms.eligibility: The application is reserved for club members. Each account is matched to the corresponding membership in AssoConnect. For a minor member, membership signed by their legal guardian constitutes agreement to use the tool.
terms.personalAccount: An account is personal: do not lend it to anyone or share your password.
terms.displayName: Choose a display name that lets other members recognise you, without being mocking or offensive.
terms.forgottenPassword: If you forget your password, contact a club administrator, who will give you a temporary one.
terms.conduct: The rules are simple: be courteous and use the tool for its intended purpose. In practice:
terms.respectfulWriting: write respectfully: no insults, mockery or hurtful remarks about a member, whether in notes or handovers;
terms.ownPhoto: only add a photo of yourself as your profile photo, never someone else's;
terms.appropriateContent: write only what belongs in a team's notebook: no personal information about other members or content unrelated to the club;
terms.authorizedAccess: do not try to access anything you are not authorised to see, such as another team's work or another member's account.
terms.clubRules: The club's internal rules also apply to club life and workshops.
terms.ownership: What you write in your team's notebook becomes part of its history: it remains in the club's archives after you leave, without your name, since your account is then anonymised (see the privacy policy). The club may use extracts in its competition portfolios, always respecting image-consent decisions.
terms.moderation: If these rules are broken, a club administrator may edit or remove content and suspend an account. Suspension is temporary and does not erase anything. These decisions are made with the club's leaders, as with any conduct issue.
terms.availability: The application runs on a club computer. Volunteers provide it as is, without guaranteeing permanent availability: a failure or maintenance may make it temporarily inaccessible.
terms.changes: These terms may change. The update date at the top of this page identifies the latest version.
terms.data: What the application records and your rights over that data are described in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
